entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So these are the innermost depths of[n]Kaneshiro's heart...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Passwords? It seems he has placed locks[n]on his most treasured secrets...
entries.uk: Паролі? Схоже, він замкнув[n]свої найцінніші таємниці...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But what would he want to hide?
entries.uk: Але що б він хотів приховати?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...It would have to be inferiority[n]complexes of some sort.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We will just need to reveal the[n]deficiencies he believes he holds.
entries.uk: Нам лише треба розкрити вади,[n]які він за собою бачить.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do that, and we will reach the true[n]depths of his heart. Yes, this is quite[n]the simple task.
entries.uk: Зробимо це — і дістанемося справжніх[n]глибин його серця. Так, завдання[n]доволі просте.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, what was it that he desired?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah, yes. Money... As long as he had[n]enough money, he felt anything was[n]possible...
entries.uk: Ах, так. Грошей... Поки в нього було[n]досить грошей, він вважав, що може[n]все...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Or... perhaps it was the other way[n]around...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Without it, he was nothing. Hence, his[n]insecurities must be about things that[n]cannot be bought...
entries.uk: Без них він був ніким. Отже, його[n]комплекси мають стосуватися того,[n]чого не купиш...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In that case...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wh-What the...? I don't get a damn thing[n]that's goin' through her head right now...
entries.uk: Щ-що за...? Я ні чорта не розумію,[n]що в неї зараз у голові...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems all we can do is observe at[n]this point.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ultimately, the reason Kaneshiro began[n]worshipping money...
entries.uk: Зрештою, причина, з якої Канешіро[n]почав поклонятися грошам...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Was to make up for the inferiority[n]complexes he held deep within.
entries.uk: Була в тому, щоб компенсувати глибоко[n]приховані комплекси.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Very well. The first insecurity is...
His gravelly voice.
His ugly looks.
His receding hairline.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now, for the second one.
He was an only child.
He has no friends.
He was poor growing up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay, only one more remains...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The last insecurity is...
His bad B.O.
His stupidity.
His unathletic physique.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Yes!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, holy shit! You're a freakin' genius,[n]Miss President!
entries.uk: Чувак, оце так! Ти ж просто геній,[n]пані президентко!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have nothing but praise for this result[n]as well.
entries.uk: Я теж можу лише похвалити цей[n]результат.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You did it, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was nothing.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This isn't the end though. Actually, it's[n]about to get a lot more difficult...
entries.uk: Але це ще не кінець. Власне, зараз[n]стане набагато складніше...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, time to corner Kaneshiro! Let's go!
entries.uk: Що ж, пора загнати Канешіро в кут![n]Ходімо!
